faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?

faq.q: How is a titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial) manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial) is manufactured using Closed-die forging; 5-axis CNC machining; Heat treatment (STA); Shot peening. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
faq.a: Titanium LPT Blade (Gamma-TiAl) components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348, ASME. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply depending on the application and regulatory requirements.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial) components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.

faq.q: What surface treatments are available for titanium lpt blade (gamma-tial)?
